Fuelling Imagination through Puppetry

Upcoming Shows

The Pied Piper: A Rat's Tale

The Pied Piper: A Rat's Tale

24 September–7 November 2026
You think know the story of the Pied Piper of Hamelin ?— But do you? Meet Horatio, the brave little rat behind the legend! With puppetry, storytelling and original music, The Pied Piper: A Rat’s Tale is a funny and imaginative family show that reveals the story behind the story. 

For everyone over 5

Pip and Posy Live on Stage

Pip and Posy Live on Stage

23 September–22 November 2026
Inspired by the BAFTA nominated animated series from Magic Light Pictures and based on the picture books by multi-award-winning illustrator Axel Scheffler (The Gruffalo) this exciting new live stage show celebrates the power of imagination, kindness, and creativity for little ones and families everywhere.

Aimed at ages 2-5

Little Angel Theatre were The Stage Awards’ Fringe Theatre of the Year in 2024!

Make a donation today to help Little Angel Theatre give the gift of puppetry to as many children as possible.

Suggested donations:

  • £5 per month helps pay for materials for our ongoing free workshops in the community
  • £25 per month helps pay for performances of our suitcase show to isolated children in hospital or a refugee family in a bridging hotel
  • £50 per month helps pay for tickets for local school children to attend our shows
  • £100 per month helps to support our artist development work, creating the puppeteers and puppet makers of the future

🙏 Donate now

If you are able to support us, any donation, large or small, will make a huge difference.

All amounts are welcome. Thank you!
